name: SLVEST
recent: SLVEST 近期签署了一份谅解备忘录，并发布了季度业绩。同时，公司因员工行使 ESOS 而多次发行新股，主要股东 Prudential PLC 的持股变动也多次公告。
notable: 签署了一份谅解备忘录。
员工行使 ESOS，公司分多次发行新股。
Prudential PLC 成为主要股东，并多次申报持股变动。
risks: 首席营运官 Yap Pei Koon 行使 ESOS 后出售了部分股份。
Urusharta Jamaah Sdn. Bhd. 不再是公司主要股东。

recent_en: SLVEST recently entered into a memorandum of understanding and released its quarterly results. Meanwhile, the company issued new shares multiple times due to employees exercising ESOS, and there were several announcements on shareholding changes by substantial shareholder Prudential PLC.
notable_en: Entered into a memorandum of understanding.
Issued new shares multiple times due to employees exercising ESOS.
Prudential PLC became a substantial shareholder and filed multiple shareholding change notices.
risks_en: Chief Operating Officer Yap Pei Koon disposed of some shares after exercising ESOS.
Urusharta Jamaah Sdn. Bhd. ceased to be a substantial shareholder.
earnings_en: Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was MYR 155,937,000 with net income of MYR 19,019,000, net margin 12.2%. Revenue declined 42.0% QoQ and net income fell 21.3% QoQ; however, revenue grew 13.2% YoY and net income rose 19.8% YoY.
